unit.why: An exemplary tale quoted from an earlier ethical book (ס׳ א״ו, שער התפלה), told in the name of R. N.: a dying man sees the Angel of Death with dogs, and an angel saves him because of his thoughts of repentance; no Hasidic figure appears.
unit.boundary_note: the closing heading 'מענין חול המועד' introduces the next division

stories.start_quote: מעשה אירע בעיר אחת באדם אחד
stories.summary_en: A dying man cries out that a figure full of eyes and a pack of dogs are about to tear him apart; while sages pray for him, a figure clothed in linen drives the dogs off and tells him that his thoughts of repentance saved him, but because he never repented in deed he was frightened.
